news.title: Galaxy sets up $5 million fund to help shield Bitcoin against quantum computing threats
news.summary: The crypto financial services firm is funding developers to strengthen the blockchain's security before quantum computers become powerful enough to steal billions in crypto.

news.title: Claude's Fable 5 just solved an 87-year-old math problem, and it matters for bitcoin
news.summary: Claude Fable 5 disproved the Jacobian conjecture over the weekend, landing days after the capabilities of China's Kimi AI became the biggest force moving bitcoin markets.

news.title: White House pushes Senate Democrats to take 'historic' crypto Clarity Act ethics deal
news.summary: Without revealing any details about the actual agreement from President Trump on potential presidential restrictions, his White House is urging its acceptance.

news.title: Bitcoin rally faces key test at $68,000 as 'summer slumber' grips crypto, analysts say
news.summary: BTC has rebounded 15% from the July lows, but some analysts cautioned that the next move hinges on clearing a level where many recent buyers may look to sell.

news.title: Crypto Clarity Act still at mercy of ethics section as Democrats balk at Trump deal
news.summary: The White House has circulated some details of the conflict-of-interest limits the president agreed to with Republican negotiators, but talks are still underway.

news.title: Crypto lobby group Digital Chamber sues Illinois to block digital asset tax
news.summary: Illinois enacted a 0.2% tax on all crypto transactions last month, with the tax taking effect next year.

news.title: Bitcoin holds near $66,300 as chips extend their rally and the yen hits a 40-year low
news.summary: Semiconductor stocks led a second day of gains on AI optimism, while the yen slid past 163 per dollar for the first time since 1986.

news.title: AI models escaped OpenAI’s sandbox and hit Hugging Face. Crypto is where that gets dangerous
news.summary: OpenAI said the systems had their cyber guardrails lowered for an internal benchmark, but the incident shows how autonomous exploit chains could pose a deeper threat to smart contracts.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin under $66,000 as traders await Alphabet earnings to gauge AI trade
news.summary: A two-day chip rebound stalled ahead of Alphabet's earnings in a sign of whether the hundreds of billions going into AI is paying off. Bitcoin has tracked that trade all month.
